groups.heading: Meet the executive team!
groups.intro: Get to know the dedicated individuals leading our organization! Hover over or tap a card to read a short bio.

members.name: Jordan Kennedy
members.bio: "I am a Senior at the University of Oklahoma, and am double majoring in International Studies and Political Science. I got involved in Model UN because of my passion for foreign affairs and educating people about the importance of the UN."

members.name: Sam Pritchard
members.bio: "I am a Junior at the University of Oklahoma. I'm pursuing a B.S. in Psychology, and a dual minor in Latin and Film and Media Studies. I got involved with Model United Nations as an executive because I believe that it promotes research literacy as well as interpersonal skills in its members."

members.name: Graham Harris
members.bio: "I am a sophomore at the University of Oklahoma majoring in Economics-Pre Law with a minor in history! I got involved in Model United Nations due to my interest in geopolitics, in which this club allows you to truly experience working within a international diplomatic framework."

groups.heading: Meet the Board of Trustees!
groups.intro: Get to know the individuals assisting in the leadership of our organization! Hover over or tap a card to read a short bio.

members.name: Joe Pittenger
members.bio: I am a freshman here at the University of Oklahoma majoring in meteorology and mathematics! I am involved in Model United Nations as I believe in the importance of multidisciplinary study, as well as being an informed global citizen.
